name: Rothesay
method: tidetimes.org.uk Rothesay vs its own Millport (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Millport: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: Height = offset + scale * Millport: Rothesay's range is ~10% bigger. HW is ~10 min before Millport's and scatters ~5 min round it. One height map for HW and LW: separate ones fitted under 0.01 m better but don't cross inside the range, so the curve would miss the low water heights. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Rothesay vs Millport, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 544 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
